public.title: First Missing Positive
public.description: Return the smallest positive integer absent from values. Unsorted input may contain duplicates, zeros and negatives. There are 0 to 1000 integers between -1000000 and 1000000. Aim for O(n) time and constant extra space; input mutation is permitted.
hints: Place each value x from 1 through n at index x-1.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Cyclic placement puts every present candidate in its slot; the first incorrect slot identifies the answer. Time O(n). The reference copies input for clarity, using O(n) space; applying the same swaps directly to the permitted mutable input uses O(1) auxiliary space.
